The Pinwheels and Ribbon Cowl is a simple piece that allows you to sew one pinwheel and one ribbon at a time; Sew a few pins straight, then sew a few pins back to get a rib. For a small teepee you can make either three or four rows of ribbon, or a longer, more streamlined “drape” (rows of pinwheels make the fabric wider, and rows of ribbon keep it from creasing; that’s why you want fewer rows of ribbon).
